optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Change Management Specialist, Mobile App Services
professionalSummary: Experienced in preparing and quality‑checking change requests for fortnightly mobile app releases, ensuring rollback plans, test evidence, and ownership are documented before submission to the change advisory board.  Skilled at recording board decisions, maintaining the release calendar, coordinating pre‑freeze activities with engineering squads and QA, and producing post‑release summaries that capture incidents, rollbacks, and open items.  Demonstrated ability to manage the full change management cycle for a consumer banking app over a year.
experienceHighlights: Prepared change requests for eleven fortnightly releases, verifying rollback plans, linking test evidence, and assigning owners before board submission.  (src_5e0365a979ba)
Recorded change advisory board decisions in the change tool and kept the release calendar current; published go/no‑go outcomes to squads.  (src_50fb09fecfbb)
Ran pre‑freeze checklists with four app squads and QA, chasing open items and escalating unresolved ones to the operations manager two days before freeze.  (src_59390e9c15d4)
Wrote post‑release summaries listing incidents, rollbacks, and carried‑over open items, reviewed by the operations manager.  (src_0702d02da233)
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised change‑request pack for one release, including request list, rollback plans, test‑evidence links, board decision record, and post‑release summary with audit trail.  (src_82582aeab6c9)
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience in change request preparation, board record keeping, pre‑freeze coordination, and post‑release reporting for a mobile banking app.  They do not provide evidence of the candidate’s ability to document known limitations and hand‑over conditions for each release cycle (req_c08fb548a158).

role.roleTitle: Change Management Specialist, Mobile App Services

evidence.text: Prepared change requests for eleven fortnightly releases of the banking app, checking each request for a rollback plan, linked test evidence and a named owner before submission to the change advisory board.
Recorded change advisory board decisions in the change tool and kept the release calendar current; the board chair took the go/no-go decision and I published the outcome to the squads.
Ran the pre-freeze checklist with the four app squads and QA, chasing open items and escalating unresolved ones to the operations manager two days before each freeze.
Wrote the post-release summary for each cycle, listing incidents, any rollback and the open items carried into the next cycle, which the operations manager reviewed.
